data.content_ref: inline:The target argues that the oracle used to adjudicate the critics cannot distinguish agreement from correctness because the ground-truth artifact's own truth is indeterminate. But that is precisely a reason to conclude the §11.3 flags are NOT reliably sustained — the adjudication is epistemically unsound. The target instead affirms 'flags are sustained' while simultaneously demonstrating the adjudication mechanism is invalid, so the defense of 'sustained' is self-defeating: if the oracle only tests agreement with a possibly-false SRC_005, then the sustained flags may be artifacts of oracle error rather than genuine critic faults. The target cannot both vindicate the flags and impeach the only mechanism that produced them.
